package rulefixtures

// scenario for passthrough_wrapper_interface: Wrapper structs that mostly forward one-to-one through an interface field with little added policy.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.

type UserStore interface {
	Create(name string, email string) (int, error)
	FindByID(id int) (*User, error)
	Update(id int, name string) error
	Delete(id int) error
}

type UserStoreWrapper struct {
	store UserStore
}

func (w *UserStoreWrapper) Create(name string, email string) (int, error) {
	return w.store.Create(name, email)
}

func (w *UserStoreWrapper) FindByID(id int) (*User, error) {
	return w.store.FindByID(id)
}

func (w *UserStoreWrapper) Update(id int, name string) error {
	return w.store.Update(id, name)
}

func (w *UserStoreWrapper) Delete(id int) error {
	return w.store.Delete(id)
}

type User struct {
	ID    int
	Name  string
	Email string
}
